title: Definition.
partHeading: PART III. PAPER BALLOT VOTING SYSTEM
bodyText:
PART III. PAPER BALLOT VOTING SYSTEM

"Paper ballot voting system" means the method of recording votes which are counted manually.

annotations.heading: Note
annotations.text: Part heading amended by L 1975, c 36, §5(3).

bodyHtml:
PART III.  PAPER BALLOT VOTING SYSTEM

 

Note

 

  Part heading amended by L 1975, c 36, §5(3).

 

     §16-21  Definition.  "Paper ballot voting system" means the method of recording votes which are counted manually. [L 1970, c 26, pt of §2; am L 1975, c 36, §5(4)]
